reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name,
  (SELECT ph.list_price_eur FROM price_history ph WHERE ph.product_id = p.product_id AND ph.valid_to IS NULL) AS list_price_eur
FROM products p
WHERE p.category_id = 16
alternatives:
SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, ph.list_price_eur
FROM products p
JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = p.product_id AND ph.valid_to IS NULL
WHERE p.category_id = 16

WITH current_prices AS (
  -- one row per product
  SELECT product_id, list_price_eur
  FROM price_history
  WHERE valid_to IS NULL
)
SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, c.list_price_eur
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN current_prices c ON c.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.category_id = 16

other_way.sql:
SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, ph.list_price_eur
FROM products p
JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = p.product_id AND ph.valid_to IS NULL
WHERE p.category_id = 16
other_way.tradeoff: A join to the current price rows gives the same list; the subquery in SELECT shows the one-value lookup per product.
